commits.summary: Complete the beyond-JBMC campaign and verify its final evidence
commits.body:
The final Lean kernel proof establishes injectivity of the 128-bit Commons Codec seed transformation for fixed blocks, length and tail. It establishes the exact signed seed boundary, binds all three released JARs and the common 1.14 and 1.15 bytecode, and rejects the deliberately incorrect identity.

The index covers 187 historical claims, two regression populations of 60 and 49, 32 historical upgrades, 68 disclosed work items and 16 blind pairs. It accounts for all 89 jobs, including four earlier failures with successful replacements. The 203 property comparisons and 24 release comparisons have local evidence. The eight published report pages passed the link audit and all 10 selected Python tests passed.
